doc.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995

title: Oddball gigs
summary: He cannot recall an oddball gig.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: Before we wrap up, you just mentioned playing at a fashion show. You know it’s interesting the kind of things that people don’t maybe think about, where you have played, you know different functions that you’ve played for. Has there been one thing that you could recollect that was like a real oddball type of gig that you played? That’s a hard question I know.
I’d have to give that some thought.
Most people have them, but you kind of put them back here so they’re not—
I’d have to think that over. I can’t come up with it.
